cue_start_first: Start cooking or plant a crop first. There is nothing new to wait for yet.
cue_watching: You'll hear one alert when this meal or crop is ready. Pausing, a fault or loading a save cancels the alert.
cue_completed: Ready. Collect your meal or harvest the crop. Set another alert for the next batch.
loot_enabled_setting: Allow Agriculture supplies in newly stocked fridges and crates, and loose machinery among engineering finds. Existing contents and shops are unchanged. Restart after changing.
loot_multiplier_setting: Chance of Agriculture finds (0 off; 1 normal; maximum 3). Each place that can stock them gets at most one extra item. Shops are unchanged. Restart after changing.
skip_room_setting: Room conditions during time skips. Off (normal): the game pauses breathing, air scrubbers, coolers and the air through open doors while time skips, so Agriculture machines give off no room heat then, room temperature does not hold them back, and a crop short of CO2 waits without harm. On: rooms count as in play, so a grow room can overheat and crops can stall and lose health in a long skip.
rack_desc:
Verdemorrow Agronomics believes a working ship can have a growing corner. The Firstlight-4 brings fresh food within reach of the galley, four tiles square with room for 20 kg of water and 0.5 kg of nutrients. A crop to tend, a harvest to share, and something aboard that is here to live.

Load water and feed through Inventory, or let a linked Groundwork W2 supply them. Choose the crop and keep its growing conditions suitable. The rack still needs power, replenishment and care. Where we go, life grows.
cooker_desc:
Verdemorrow's Hearth-2 gives the end of a shift a smell worth coming home to. Two tiles square, drawing 2 kW: hot potatoes in 90 seconds, flatbread in ten minutes or soybean stew in fifteen.

Each batch takes a 0.4 kg potato portion, 0.4 kg of wheat grain with a water ration, or 0.25 kg of soybeans with a water ration. The spare heat stays in the cabin. Leave yourself a place to sit. The meal is ready to be more than another item on the supplies list.
potato_seed_desc:
Verdemorrow's Continuance planting stock puts the next potato harvest in your hands. Viable tubers from the crop can start another planting, carrying a little of the growing corner forward with you.

Keep these for the rack, away from the dinner tray. Tomorrow's meal needs something left to plant.
lettuce_seed_desc:
Verdemorrow's Continuance lettuce seeds promise a welcome crunch after too many sealed meals. One packet starts one planting beneath the rack lights.

A crop grown for seed can replace the packet; a leaf harvest cannot. Choose what this planting is for before you start counting the next one.
wheat_seed_desc:
Verdemorrow's Continuance seed wheat brings the possibility of fresh bread aboard. This dwarf variety stays short beneath rack lights: one packet sows one rack, with a replacement packet returned at harvest.

The seed is a beginning. Water, feed and a tended growing room carry it through to the galley.
tomato_seed_desc:
Verdemorrow's Continuance tomato seeds are for captains who remember what a ripe tomato ought to taste like. A compact dwarf plant suited to rack lights, with one packet for one rack and a replacement saved from the final fruit harvest.

Give the roots their supplies and the plants suitable conditions. Some comforts are worth making room to grow.
soybean_seed_desc:
Verdemorrow's Continuance soybean seed puts a warm bowl from the galley on the far side of a growing shift. One packet sows one rack; the harvest returns another packet for planting.

Keep water and feed behind the crop, and cook the beans before eating. A useful harvest deserves a proper meal.
flax_seed_desc:
Verdemorrow's Continuance fibre flax grows something the galley cannot supply: stems for cloth, with woody material left for the straw press. A dense, tall stand under the rack lights, started by one packet per rack and returning a packet at harvest.

A Groundwork B2 works the harvested straw. Feed the crop first; put its useful parts to work afterwards.
beet_seed_desc:
Verdemorrow's Continuance sugar beet seed brings a little sweetness into a ship's working supplies. One packet sows one rack and the harvest returns a replacement. The roots can go to a Groundwork B2 for sugar or an Alembrine still for another end to the shift.

Water, nutrients and suitable growing conditions remain part of the bargain. The packet starts the crop; a tended rack brings it home.
nutrients_desc:
Verdemorrow's Groundwork feed puts the rack's next growing shift in a packet. A prepared nutrient blend for Firstlight crops, ready for the supplies that keep a shipboard harvest coming.

Use formulated feed in the rack or W2. Raw ore and wastewater cannot stand in for it. Fresh leaves are a welcome change from station packets; the roots still need their own supplies.
raw_desc: A galley's worth of promise. Cook this portion in the Hearth-2 before eating.
meal_desc: Hot potatoes from the galley. A proper meal after a shift in the boneyard.
leaves_desc: Fresh leaves grown aboard ship. A light bite and a welcome change from packaged meals.
wheat_grain_desc: Dry grain from the rack. It keeps for as long as you need it to. Bake it in the Hearth-2 with a water ration; chewing it raw is for the desperate.
flatbread_desc: A round of hot flatbread from the galley. Filling enough to carry a shift, and it smells like somewhere with weather.
tomatoes_desc: Ripe tomatoes off the vine. Mostly water and entirely worth it after a month of ration paste.
soybeans_desc: Dry beans that keep for as long as you need them to. Cook them in the Hearth-2 with a water ration; raw, they are a bad idea.
flax_straw_desc: A bundle of pulled, retted flax stems. Scutch it at a Groundwork B2 for two clean scrap cloth, the kind bed and medical-bed repairs and weapon buffing use; the woody leftovers go to the straw press.
sugar_beets_desc: A fat, pale root that is mostly water and a sixth sugar. Extract the sugar at a Groundwork B2, or mash it in a fermenter. Eating it raw is technically possible and not recommended.
beet_sugar_desc: White sugar from the B2. A spoonful keeps a tired crew member going a little longer; a fermenter turns it into spirit.
soybean_stew_desc: A bowl of beans in broth. Heavy, warm and full of protein: it keeps a crew going longer than it has any right to.
residue_desc: Older crop waste with no record of its nutrients. B2 cannot recover feed from it. Mass varies.
drainage_desc: Older growing water with no nutrient record. Cannot be treated. Do not drink.
missing_package: Enable the Phobos Agriculture content package that matches this plugin.
protected: Stopped to protect saved contents or settings that could not be checked safely. See the log for details.
resumed: Carried on after loading the game.
fault: Stopped after a fault. Contents have been kept. Check the log for details.
gap: Stopped after a gap in readings. No growth was added for that time. Resume when ready.
access: An awake crew member must stand beside unlocked equipment on this ship. Remote use needs a powered console you can access.
local_work: Send a crew member to work beside the machine.
queued: Work queued for crew. Supplies and space for the results will be checked again before completion.
repair: Install and repair the equipment first.

not_ready: Crop is not ready to harvest.
pick_none: Nothing to pick: the plant is not ripe yet, or it has given all its picks. Harvest it to finish the planting.
picks_status: Picks taken: {0} of {1}. Harvest takes the rest and ends the planting.
co2_growth: Cabin CO2 {0:0.00} kPa: growth x{1:0.00}. About 0.10 to 0.15 kPa grows fastest; much more slows it again.
full: No room for the results. Contents have been kept.
rack_full: {0}: its rack is full. Take something out of its inventory, then try again.
panel_help: Put supplies in Inventory and collect results there. Crew do the planting, loading and harvesting. Pausing the controls doesn't stop plants breathing.
build_desc: Assemble an empty appliance, ready to install.
unload_first: Remove the crop and empty all contents before uninstalling or dismantling.
no_provider: No compatible Ship's Water supply. Load irrigation charges or water rations by hand.
cooker_supply_missing: The cooking is done except for its supply: bread and stew need a water ration in the cooker. Add one and choose Start to finish it.
crop_dead: Crop lost. Clear the dead plants to plant again.
crop_stress: Poor growing conditions for {0:0.0} h; check cabin, power and supplies.
crop_stress_cause: Poor growing conditions for {0:0.0} h: {1}. Health starts to fall after {2:0.#} h.
crop_recovering: Recovering from {0:0.0} h of poor growing conditions. Good conditions win it back hour for hour.
stress_power: not enough power for the lamps
stress_carbon: too little CO2 in the room
stress_room: the room is outside this crop's limits
carbon_low: Growth held back by too little CO2 in the room.
carbon_skip: Short of CO2 in the time skip. Nobody breathes while time skips, so the crop waits without harm.
power_low: Not enough power for the growing rack.
irrigation_desc: Groundwork water for thirsty roots. Needs 5 kg of free tank space. Not drinking water; cannot be decanted into drinking supplies. The listed mass counts water only.
irrigation_full: Make {0} kg of room in the tank first. The water charge is still here.
water_supply_desc:
Verdemorrow's Groundwork W2 keeps the growing corner supplied while the rest of the ship has a shift to finish. One 0.18 kW pump serves up to eight linked racks, from a two-by-two unit weighing 20 kg empty and holding 20 kg of water and 0.5 kg of nutrients.

Groundwork feed goes in Inventory or a nutrient hopper within one tile. Load water by hand or draw from compatible Ship's Water tanks. A treatment cartridge adds 0.5 kW drainage recovery, giving some used growing water another turn. This is process water, not drinking water. Your plants can share a supply; they still need you to keep it stocked.
water_pipe_desc:
Verdemorrow's irrigation pipe gives the W2 a route to the roots. One tile of pipe weighs 1 kg, joins north, south, east and west, and connects to racks and W2 units it runs under or beside. Crossings join the same run.

The W2 fills the pipe first, about 0.2 kg of water per tile. The water stays until drained into a canister. Plan the run before you plant; drain it before you move it. A growing corner deserves plumbing as much as the engine room does.
water_not_ready: {0} must be installed, undamaged, unlocked and on this ship, with no saved-settings fault, before its water link can change.
water_wrong_kind: A W2 links to cultivation racks, and a rack to a W2.
water_bank_full: {0} already feeds eight racks. Unlink one of them at that W2 first; which one is up to you.
override_pause: {0} will pause for the change and carry on afterwards.
override_clear_link: The unreadable old link on {0} will be cleared first.
override_cancel_cooking: This batch's portion is missing. Pressing again cancels the batch, losing its {0:0}% of cooking, and starts a new one from what is in the cooker. To keep the batch, put its portion back instead.
water_missing: The selected water connection is unavailable.
water_no_conduit: This W2 and rack are not joined. Lay irrigation pipe from under or right beside the W2 to under or right beside the rack, or put them within one tile of each other. Racks never link across open floor.
water_no_route: No working pipe connection. Check the links, the irrigation pipe and the floor or wall under it.
water_route_length: Connected through about {0} tiles of irrigation pipe
line_drain: This rack still holds water that was in its pipes before an update. Start the W2 so it arrives, or drain the rack, before changing this.
line_drain_named: {0} still holds water that was in its pipes before an update. Start its W2 so the water arrives, or drain the rack, before changing this.
line_flow: Estimated maximum flow: {0:0.0}% through {1} pipe tiles. Calculated outlet pressure: {2:0.0} kPa at rated pump pressure. Not a sensor reading.
recover-solution: Queue drainage treatment (15 minutes; then Start)
recovery_input: Put Recorded Process Solution and a cartridge with enough capacity in W2 Inventory. Each batch must fit one cartridge. Older saved jobs need their original unused cartridge. Return the batch's supplies or cancel treatment.
recovery_ready: Treatment queued. Start W2 when ready. It uses power and stops water distribution while treating the batch.
recovery_capacity: Treatment ready, but the recovered water and nutrients won't fit. Make room in the tank, then press Start.
recovery_progress: Treatment electricity used: {0:0.0}% of the batch's needs.
characterized_drainage_desc: Used growing water with its nutrient content recorded. W2 can recover some of it with a treatment cartridge and power. Older unrecorded waste cannot be used. Do not drink.
recovery_cartridge_desc:
Verdemorrow's Groundwork treatment cartridge gives used growing water another turn at the roots. A fresh cartridge carries 0.05 kg of treatment medium for 25 kg of drainage whose nutrient contents are recorded.

Treatment uses 0.002 kg of medium per kilogram of water. Keep a partly used cartridge for the next run. Some water and nutrients remain in the rejects; none becomes drinking water. Stretch the growing supply, then replenish what the process cannot bring back.
recovery_reject_desc: Used filter material with water and nutrients the treatment couldn't recover. Cannot be treated again. Not food or drinking water.
recovery_status: Treating batch {0}; power used: {1:0.0000} kWh. Return its supplies, or pause and Cancel treatment.
recovery_capacity_status: Cartridge can treat {0:0.000} kg more drainage. A whole batch must fit one cartridge. Keep the remaining capacity for later; treatment rates are set for play.
recovery_legacy: Older saved job: uses one whole unused cartridge per batch.
workup_bench_desc:
Verdemorrow's Groundwork B2 keeps another useful shift in the harvest. Recover nutrient concentrate from recorded crop residue, work flax into clean scrap cloth, extract beet sugar or press crop waste into dry straw. Two tiles square: a small workroom for more of what your racks produce.

Nutrient concentrate takes an equal mass of Groundwork makeup salts to become complete feed. The straw press makes 1 kg bales and sends recovered water to a touching or line-linked tank. Nutrient work draws 0.5 kW; drying draws 1 kW. Recovery leaves remainders and needs replenishment. The B2 helps you use more of a crop, without promising the next crop for nothing.
recorded_residue_desc: Fresh crop waste with a record of the nutrients used to grow it. Feed it to B2 for recovery. Older unrecorded waste and already-processed plant matter cannot be used.
concentrate_desc: Recovered nutrients that aren't yet a complete feed. Mix with an equal mass of makeup salts at B2 before using in W2. Mass varies. Do not drink.
spent_biomass_desc: Wet plant matter left after B2 has recovered what it can. Nothing more to extract here. Mass varies.
makeup_desc:
Verdemorrow's Groundwork makeup salts supply the missing half of recovered feed. Combine with an equal mass of recorded concentrate at a B2, and put another useful share of the old crop behind the next one.

Keep partly used packets. Repair and Restore cannot replace salts already consumed. Recovery earns a second use; replenishment keeps it going.
mixture_desc: Plant feed mixed at B2. Put it in W2 Inventory, pause, select the charge and crop mix, then Start. Used only while the mixer has power; the panel shows what's left. Repair and Restore cannot refill it.
workup_queued: Supplies set aside. Start when ready and leave room for all results. A job that was running carries on after loading a save.
workup_input: Load recorded crop residue, recorded concentrate with enough makeup salts, a flax straw bundle or a sugar beet. Keep the supplies in this bench until the job finishes.
dose_empty: No nutrient source. Put Groundwork nutrients in Inventory, or set a nutrient hopper within one tile. Nutrients already aboard can still be fed.
dose_status: Stocking from {0}: {1:0.000} g left ({2:0.0}%). Repair and Restore cannot refill it.
consumable_no_repair: Repair and Restore cannot refill used supplies.
wet_rejects_desc: Wet waste from Valtora's Ship's Water 0.16.1 Recycler. Not fertilizer: B2 cannot process it. Holds up to 13 kg per packet. Water uses a simplified 1 kg/L conversion.
capture_unavailable: Needs Valtora's Ship's Water 0.16.1 Recycler and a compatible Phobos Shipbreaker collector.
capture_access: Stand beside both machines. They must be working and unlocked on this ship. Put the collector's two-tile pocket against the Recycler, service side facing away. Floor mounts need two structural floor tiles and a clear two-tile service walkway. Hull mounts still need their usual supports.
capture_held_elsewhere: {0} already takes residue from {1}, which Phobos Shipbreaker manages. Unlink it at that collector first.
capture-unlink: Detach collector and restore ordinary recycling
capture_enabled: Collection on. Waiting for a working powered collector with room for the wet waste.
capture_paused: Collection paused. Enable it again after loading a save.
dose-inventory: Use first nutrient charge in Inventory
crew_recipe_cook: Cook what the galley has: potatoes, bread or soybean stew
crew_select_recipe: Choose what to grow or make here.
crew_supplies: Need approved supplies or more storage space. Seed stock and the crew's drinking-water reserve stay protected.
panel_live: Progress {0:0}% · Health {1:0}% · Water {2:0.00} kg · Nutrients {3:0.000} kg
bulk_nutrients_desc:
Verdemorrow's Groundwork bulk charge carries 500 g of dry plant feed for a W2. A reserve for more than one hurried refill, supplied without water so your tank can do its own job.

Select the charge in Inventory for gradual mixing, or enable the replacement standing order for crew to fit the next one. Mass and value fall as the feed is used. Repair cannot refill it. Keep a spare before the next growing shift needs one.
bulk-drain: Drain up to 20 kg for treatment (some is lost)
bulk_pair: Place an intact water silo within one tile of the W2 (touching or one tile apart, diagonals count), or lay a process-water line so it runs under or right beside both.
bulk_reserve_paused: Reserve set. Paused for the new reserve: {0}. Start them again when ready.
bulk_quote_changed: The destination or room in it changed. Choose the quantity again for a fresh quote.
bulk_catch_wait: Repair the tank and recover the trapped water beside it before filling.
crew_recipe_bulk-fill: Keep the silo stocked with irrigation charges
crew_recipe_supply-charges: Keep the racks supplied and the W2 stocked with nutrients
bulk_intake_wait: Waiting. Check the silo's water and reserve, damage, the connection, service access and room in the W2. This connection draws from the linked silo only.
bulk_intake_ready: Ready when intake is enabled. Shares W2's pump power.
shipswater_unreached: No Ship's Water tank touches this machine or shares its water line, so it draws no drinking water. Place a tank within a tile of it, or lay process-water line so it runs under or right beside both.
Maintenance.ready: Ready for removal. You still need crew access, tools and materials for the job.
Maintenance.protected: A saved transfer or process needs attention. Keep the equipment in place and inspect its control panel before maintenance.
Maintenance.tank: Drain the tank before removing or dismantling it.
Maintenance.link: Unlink the empty tank from its equipment before removal.
Maintenance.contents: Remove crops, food, nutrients and all remaining water or feed before moving this equipment. Check its supply and pipe contents in the Control Panel.
Maintenance.job: Finish or cancel the cooking or workup job before removing this equipment.
accept_done: Contents accepted. The machine's weight now matches its saved contents and it can be used again.
accept_unavailable: Cannot accept these contents. Their saved record cannot be read, or the equipment needs repair first.
crop_present: A crop is already planted. Harvest or clear it first.
bulk_tank_details: {0:F0} kg of water for the next growing shift. This {1} x {1} tank weighs {2:F0} kg empty and needs no power. A W2 within one tile pumps from it. Damage traps water in a catch tank: repair, then recover it. Drain before moving or dismantling. Not for drinking water.
bulk_tank_desc:
Verdemorrow's Groundwork reservoir puts a water reserve behind the growing shift. Process water stays accounted for by the kilogram, ready for a W2 within one tile; select the link on the W2's Supplies page.

Growing water belongs here. Drinking water belongs in the ship's drinking supplies. A planted rack is a promise worth backing with a full tank.
vessels_commodity: {0} holds {1}; the vessels file cannot change what it holds.
materials_bound: {0} must stay {1} kg at {2} cr: the crop, recovery and workup models are written for it.
crops_empty: The crops file lists no crops.
crops_id: Crop name {0} is not usable: use lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.
crops_positive: Crop {0} has a figure that is missing, negative or zero where it cannot be.
crops_limits: Crop {0} is outside what a rack can do: at most {1:F0} hours and {2:F1} kW.
crops_name: Crop {0}: a plain name is at most 40 ordinary characters.
crops_carbon: Crop {0} holds more carbon than it weighs, or its seed weighs as much as its harvest.
crops_mass: Crop {0} does not conserve mass: it takes in {1:F4} kg and grows by {2:F4} kg. Water plus nutrient plus 0.4 x carbon, less vapour, must equal final less seed.
crops_rack: Crop {0} needs more than a rack holds: at most {1:F0} kg of water and {2:F1} kg of nutrient.
crops_harvest: Crop {0} gives more than it grows: the edible share, the kept stock and one portion must fit inside the harvest.
crops_item: Crop {0} names an item this mod does not have: {1}.
crops_unit: Crop {0}: one {1} must weigh {2:R} kg, and the materials file says {3:R} kg.
crops_kept: Crop {0}: stock kept back at harvest must be exactly one planting.
crops_picks: Crop {0}: picks run from 0 to {1}, and a crop that is picked needs a pick mass of at least one portion, within its edible share and less than one cycle's growth.
crops_co2: The CO2 response needs 1 to 16 points of (kPa, factor) in rising pressure, from 0 to 10 kPa, with factors from 0.5 to 2.
crops_feed: Crop {0}: the old feed name {1} is blank, reserved or already used. A new crop can leave both old feed names out.
crops_art: Crop {0} needs the artwork name of a crop that ships with the mod, such as Potato or Lettuce.
crops_item_entry: Crop item {0} is not one of this mod's items, or its name and description text are missing.
crops_food: Crop item {0}: hunger and satiety go together, each from 1 to 20.
crops_frozen_missing: Published crop {0} is missing. A published crop can never be removed; saved plantings depend on it.
crops_frozen_changed: The file changes published crop {0}. Add a new crop beside it instead; saved plantings keep the old one.
hearth_recipe_shape: Cooking recipe {0} must take one portion and at most one supply, one unit of each, give at least one item, and say how many seconds it cooks.
hearth_recipe_item: Cooking recipe {0} names an item this mod does not have.
hearth_recipe_input: Cooking recipe {0}: another recipe already cooks {1}.
hopper_details:
Verdemorrow's Groundwork E-series keeps a growing ship's next feed supply in reserve. This {1} x {1} hopper holds {0:F0} kg of dry nutrients in a {2:F0} kg housing, with no power draw. Fill at a station's Bulk supplies kiosk, and let a W2 within one tile take feed as it mixes.

Select the hopper as the W2's nutrient source. Damage traps feed in a catch chamber: repair, then recover it. Bag the contents before moving or dismantling. A reserve is only reassuring while there is something left in it.
hopper_desc:
Verdemorrow's Groundwork hopper keeps dry plant feed ready for the long growing shift. Bulk nutrients stay together by the kilogram, while a W2 within one tile draws what its mixer needs. Choose the hopper on the W2's Supplies page.

Fill the reserve before leaving port and check it between harvests. A hopper can hold the next meal's feed; it cannot grow more of it.
hopper_status:
Nutrients ready: {0:F2} kg | Trapped: {1:F2} kg
Capacity: {2:F0} kg
hopper_catch_wait: Repair the hopper, then recover the trapped nutrients before it can dose or be filled.
hopper-bag: Bag up to 500 g as a bulk nutrient charge
dose_hopper_status: Stocking from {0}: {1:F2} kg of nutrients ready.
dose_hopper_unready: Cannot draw nutrients from {0} ({1:F2} kg ready). Check for damage, a saved-contents fault, trapped nutrients, an empty hopper or a broken connection.
Maintenance.hopper: Bag the hopper's nutrients before moving or dismantling it.
line_legacy: Water and nutrients from before an update still on their way into this rack: {0:0.000} kg. The W2 delivers them on its next powered run.
line_priming: Filling the pipes before water reaches the rack: {0:0.00} of {1:0.00} kg over {2} pipe tiles.
line_flushing: Flushing old feed out of the pipes first: {0:0.00} kg back to the W2 this step, as water and nutrients or as process solution in its inventory.
line_flush_full: The pipes still hold old feed, and the W2 has no room for it. Clear a space in its Inventory for the flushed process solution, or drain the pipes into a canister.
straw_bale_desc: A dried 1 kg bale of pressed crop waste: mostly plant fibre, a little mineral ash and some water. A Phobos Manufacturing V4 refinery can burn it into carbon dioxide and water for a grow room, or char four of them into carbon stock.
press_input: Nothing here for the press. It takes recorded crop residue and spent crop biomass from this bench, made by Agriculture 0.44.0 or later.
press_full: The straw press is full. Start the bench to dry and bale what it holds, or empty it.
press_loaded: Loaded into the straw press. It now holds {0:0.00} kg. Start the bench to dry and bale it.
press_no_tank: The straw dryer has {0:0.00} kg of water to get rid of and no tank to put it in. Place a water tank touching this bench or on its water line, with room for it, then Start again.
press_short: Not enough straw for a whole bale yet. A bale needs 0.87 kg of plant matter and 0.03 kg of minerals. Load more crop waste, or empty the press.
press_baled_rest: Pressed {0} straw bale(s). {1:0.00} kg is left in the press, waiting for more crop waste.
press_emptied: Emptied {0:0.00} kg from the straw press as recorded crop residue.
panel_press: Straw press: {0:0.00} kg, {1} bale(s) ready to press
water_route_touching: Connected directly: the W2 and rack are within one tile of each other
advice_no_air: The room has no air. A rack needs a pressurised room.
advice_room: The room is {0:0.0} C at {1:0} kPa. Crops grow between {2:0} and {3:0} C and {4:0} to {5:0} kPa.
advice_power: No power. Connect conduit to a power point on its back edge.
advice_harvest: The crop is ready. Choose Harvest.
advice_dead: The crop is dead. Choose Clear, then plant again.
advice_water_manual: No water. Load irrigation charges or water rations, or link a W2 on the Supplies page.
advice_link: No water. Link a W2 on the Supplies page.
advice_intake: Water intake is off. Choose Enable selected water supply on the Supplies page.
advice_w2_fault: {0} cannot pump: it is damaged, locked or has a saved-settings fault.
advice_w2_empty: {0} is out of water. Fill it, or link it to a water silo.
advice_w2_start: {0}'s pump is paused. Choose Start at the W2.
advice_w2_wait: Water is on its way from {0}. The pump fills the pipe first.
advice_nutrients: No nutrients. Load 40 g nutrient packets, or link a W2 that has nutrients aboard.
advice_plant: Nothing is planted. Put seed in Inventory and choose a Plant action, or enable a crew order.
advice_supply_link: No rack is linked. Link one on the Supplies page.
advice_supply_intake: No linked rack is taking water. Enable water supply at the rack.
advice_supply_empty: Out of water. Load water or link a water silo.
advice_supply_start: The pump is paused. Choose Start.
did_receive_pump: Water intake is on, and the linked W2's pump is started.
did_routed: Pipe-fed water selected. Water intake is on.
did_routed_pump: Pipe-fed water selected. Water intake is on, and the linked W2's pump is started.
did_routed_unlinked: Pipe-fed water selected. Link a W2 to feed this rack.
did_legacy: Direct refill selected. Load water by hand, or enable water supply to draw from Ship's Water tanks in reach.
did_link: Linked to {0}. Water intake is on and the pump is started.
did_link_supply: Linked to {0}. The pump is started.
